load_deepvoxels_dataset: load DeepVoxels dataset images and camera poses for a given scene from disk
parse_camera_intrinsics: parse camera intrinsics from an intrinsics.txt file and return the 4x4 intrinsic matrix
load_camera_pose: load a single 4x4 camera pose matrix from a text file on disk
convert_poses_from_dir: read all pose text files from a directory and stack them into a numpy array
split_train_val_test: split loaded images and poses into train, validation, and test index arrays
